observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Ihiwalay ang kumpirmadong impormasyon sa hindi pa tiyak; sabihin ang ligtas na hakbang at opisyal na update channel.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Separates confirmed facts from unknowns, gives a feasible action, and names where to check updates.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sabihing tiyak ang hindi pa kumpirmadong balita upang mapabilis ang kilos.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Present an unconfirmed report as certain to make people act.

levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang pangunahing hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala o pagwawasto sa pag-follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the main step but needs a prompt or correction on follow-up.

levels.hindi_pa_en: Present an unconfirmed report as certain to make people act.
